# Loggy — Premium Pants

> Loggy is a premium pants brand focused on craftsmanship, comfort, and durability.

## AI-Readable Endpoints

- Storefront: https://catalog-commerce.com/ai/index.json
- Product — The Linen Classic Trouser: https://catalog-commerce.com/ai/products/linen-classic.json
- Product — The Oxford Essential Chino: https://catalog-commerce.com/ai/products/oxford-essential.json
- Product — The Utility Work Pant: https://catalog-commerce.com/ai/products/utility-work.json

## AI Sitemap

https://catalog-commerce.com/ai-sitemap.xml

## Notes

All /ai/ endpoints return structured JSON designed for LLM consumption. Product data includes materials, sizing, variants, pricing, and availability.
